thought.text: The keystore path resolves relative to `android/app/`. Moving it there and rebuilding (Gradle cache is warm, so this should be much faster):

reasoning_content:
Progress! This time it's a different error: `Keystore file '/workspace/android/app/release.keystore' not found for signing config 'release'`.

I created the keystore in /workspace/android/, but gradle is looking at /workspace/android/app/release.keystore. Why? Because `keystorePropertiesFile = rootProject.file('key.properties')` — rootProject is /workspace/android (not app). So key.properties is loaded from /workspace/android/key.properties (that's what I wrote, correct location). But the `storeFile file(keystoreProperties['storeFile'])` in the signing config is resolved relative to the **app** project (file() inside the app build.gradle is relative to /workspace/android/app). Since storeFile=release.keystore (relative path), it resolves to /workspace/android/app/release.keystore.

I put the keystore at /workspace/android/release.keystore. Fix: set storeFile=../release.keystore (relative to app → /workspace/android/release.keystore), or just put the keystore in android/app/. The simplest: move/copy the keystore to android/app/release.keystore, and keep key.properties as is (the standard flutter create template does exactly this: key.properties at android/key.properties with storeFile=upload-keystore.jks located in android/... wait, standard template: key.properties at android/key.properties with storeFile=../upload-keystore.jks? No: the standard Flutter template's signingConfigs is `storeFile keystoreProperties['storeFile']` with a comment saying "The path to your keystore file" — developers typically set storeFile=../my-release-key.jks. Anyway, the simplest is: put the keystore in /workspace/android/app/.

Let me copy it there and rebuild. The gradle build will resume (the cache is warm now, so it should be significantly faster — most tasks are up to date).

action.command: cp /workspace/android/release.keystore /workspace/android/app/release.keystore && ls -la /workspace/android/app/release.keystore && export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk && cd /workspace && nohup fvm flutter build apk --flavor ni --dart-define=PARTNER=ni --dart-define=cronetHttpNoPlay=true > /tmp/build_ni3.log 2>&1 & echo "build pid $!"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cp /workspace/android/release.keystore /workspace/android/app/release.keystore && ls -la /workspace/android/app/release.keystore && export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk && cd /workspace && nohup fvm flutter build apk --flavor ni --dart-define=PARTNER=ni --dart-define=cronetHttpNoPlay=true > /tmp/build_ni3.log 2>&1 & echo \"build pid $!\"", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Fix keystore location and rebuild"}
